name: Goofy Planet Game
desc:
Explore 12 different star systems, including the Solar System and goof around!
Discover ancient artifacts and aliens?
Terraform 23 different objects!
Create modular bases, on land or in space!
Collect asteroids from the asteroid belt, mine ores, sell power, or grow plants!

 RECENT CHANGES:
- space station overhaul
- new sigma octantis, grecio, and new barnard system
- added console support
- full changelog in group
